name: Tycho
note: Young bright-rayed impact crater in the southern highlands.

name: Copernicus
note: Prominent terraced crater on Oceanus Procellarum.

name: Kepler
note: Small crater with a strong ray system west of Copernicus.

name: Aristarchus
note: One of the brightest large craters on the Moon.

name: Plato
note: Dark-floored crater on the northern edge of Mare Imbrium.

name: Clavius
note: Huge southern crater with a distinctive arc of internal craters.

name: Mare Imbrium
note: Large basaltic impact basin, shown as a subtle circular feature.

name: Mare Crisium
note: Isolated round mare basin on the near-side east limb.

name: Orientale Basin
note: Multi-ring basin near the western limb/far side boundary.

name: South Pole-Aitken
note: Immense ancient far-side basin near the lunar south pole.

name: Tsiolkovskiy
note: Major far-side crater with a dark basaltic floor.

name: Schrodinger
note: Large young basin near the lunar south pole.
